title: concept
description: An ontology term — one external terminology entry (the 'ontology' half of the service), written as a version-stamped snapshot at bind time (reproducibility/FAIR). Linked to CDEs via typed REPRESENTS relationships (role: primary/object_class/property/unit/value_meaning) and to permissible values via embedded concept_curie/iri. NOTE: this is the ATOMIC ontology term, not an ISO-11179 Data Element Concept (DEC = ObjectClass concept + Property concept). A composite `data_element_concept` model is a deferred, additive addition (same tier as reusable value domains); for now DEC is captured via the cde's dec_identifier/dec_name fields plus the REPRESENTS role.

concept_key.description: CURIE, used as the dedup key so re-referencing the same term does not duplicate.

curie.description: prefix:localId, e.g. MONDO:0005148, HP:0001250, SNOMEDCT:73211009, LOINC:2339-0, UCUM:mg.

concept_name.description: Human-readable term label (the ontology term's primary name, e.g. 'Head Circumference').

ontology_version.description: Version of the ontology this snapshot was taken from (drift detection).

definition.description: The term's definition from the source ontology, when available.

replaced_by.description: Successor CURIE when the term was obsoleted upstream.

cached_at.description: When this snapshot was resolved from the source.
